name: jyu_slam_fly
desc: Same character, same size, same colors and cream pattern, facing left. The head and face stay exactly the same as now: the same thick angular black eyebrows, the same half-lidded eyes and the same closed mouth, unchanged. New pose: he leaps straight sideways to the left with the body upright, the upper body leaning far back, the broad chest and the huge round belly thrust forward to the left, both arms pulled back behind him, both feet off the ground, a short tail of thick paint streaming off behind him, all inside the picture. Same outline and pixel art style.
